title: Reset a forgotten password
caption: PF-05. The token never shows in the address bar.

steps.title: Ask for a link
steps.body: Type the address, **Send the reset link**.
steps.expect: The same confirmation for every address (also unknown ones); 3 links per address an hour, then the 3-per-hour message.

steps.title: Open the link
steps.body: Open "Reset your Velexis password" and click its link.
steps.expect: A blank refresh page, then `/reset-password` without `?token=`; DevTools shows the `__Host-vxp_reset` cookie (Strict, 15 min).

steps.title: New password
steps.body: Type a new password (12+ with letter and digit), **Save the new password**.
steps.expect: 303 `/sign-in?reset=1`; every session of the account is revoked (`account_sessions.revoked_at`, `revoke_reason = 'password_change'`); e-mail "Your Velexis password was changed".

steps.title: Old link again
steps.expect: The form offers a new link (`PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN_INVALID`).
